how_to_apply: Registration is online, but the application itself is submitted offline.
Register online on the NCVT MIS web portal (www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in), then take a print of the e-mail copy showing the apprentice enrollment / registration no.
Download the application form from MbPA's website (www.mumbaiport.gov.in) under People & Career > Jobs > Advertisements. The notice states that forms are not sent by post and not sold at the ATC.
Fill the application form in all respects, with the passport-size photograph affixed.
Pay the Rs.100/- fee by NEFT to the account given above, if the fee applies to your category, and note the UTR number in the form.

Submit the duly filled form by hand delivery or by post, with the required documents and fee receipt, so that it reaches the Apprentice Training Centre (ATC), 3rd floor, Bhandar Bhavan, N. V. Nakhwa Marg, Mazgaon (East), Mumbai – 400010, on or before 18.12.2026, 5:00 pm.
The form asks for attested copies of the following, ticked in the space provided:
Apprentice Registration form (e-mail copy from www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in)
COPA / SSC / HSC / Graduation etc. mark sheet / Board Certificate
PAN card and Aadhaar card (attested photocopies)
Attested photocopy of the caste or category proof if willing to apply in a reservation category
important_instructions: After selection, the candidate enters into a Contract of Apprenticeship in the form prescribed under the Apprentices Act, 1961, to be registered with the Regional Directorate of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship (RDSDE). For a minor, the guardian or parent enters into the contract. Final selection is subject to this registration. An apprentice who abandons the contract before completing the course is liable to pay the cost of training (maximum three months' stipend) or an amount decided by RDSDE; legal action is started if this is not paid. MbPA has no obligation to offer employment during or after the apprenticeship, and the apprentice cannot claim employment on that ground. Two kinds of leave are admissible: Casual Leave 12 days and Medical Leave 15 days. The apprentice must observe the conduct rules applicable to workmen in the Port Authority. Disputes are referred to RDSDE. All apprentices get practical training at various sections / Departments of MbPA. After satisfactory completion, each appears for a test under NCVT guidelines and receives the NCVT certificate on passing. An applicant who applies as physically handicapped must produce the original certificate from a competent medical board (Persons with Benchmark Disabilities, not less than 40% disability). Without a copy of the certificate, the application is considered in the General Category. Candidature is cancelled if required original documents are not produced or a discrepancy is found. A candidate found ineligible at any stage is dismissed without notice. No daily, conveyance or travelling allowance is paid for document verification and medical examination. MbPA is not responsible for sending a reply or call to candidates not selected, and its decision on eligibility, acceptance or rejection and mode of selection is final. Help desk: 022 6656 6637 / 6625, 10:00 a.m. to 17:00 p.m., except Saturday, Sunday and holidays.

content_sections.heading: MbPA Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The stages are a merit list, verification of original documents and selection procedure at the ATC office, and a physical fitness test. The merit list is prepared on the percentage of total marks obtained in both semesters of the COPA ITI Trade Exam. Preference goes to candidates with a higher qualification in addition to the minimum educational qualification, in descending order: Post Graduate, Graduate, 3 Years Diploma and 12th Passed. If two candidates have the same marks, the older candidate is placed above. Preference is given to wards of MbPA employees; a separate merit list is prepared for wards of MbPA employees and for other candidates. The merit lists will be displayed on the notice board at the ATC office and uploaded on www.mumbaiport.gov.in . Candidates on the merit list are called to the ATC office with all original documents. The reporting date will be displayed on the ATC notice board and on www.mumbaiport.gov.in . A candidate who is not present and duly prepared on that date is rejected, the next candidate on the panel is considered, and no representation is entertained. All selected candidates undergo a physical fitness test at the MbPA Hospital, Wadala.

faq.question: Q1. How many seats are there in MbPA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 96 seats in the Computer Operator and Programming Assistant (COPA) trade, with a 12-month training period.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the MbPA COPA apprentice posts?
faq.answer: The application form must be submitted at the Apprentice Training Centre by 18.12.2026, up to 5:00 pm. Late or incomplete applications are rejected.

faq.question: Q3. What is the stipend for MbPA COPA apprentices?
faq.answer: The stipend is Rs.10,560/- per month for the 12-month training period.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for MbPA COPA apprentices?
faq.answer: Applicants must have passed the 10th Class examination under the 10+2 system of education or its equivalent, and hold a COPA Trade Certificate issued by the National Council of Vocational Training.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for MbPA COPA apprentices?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 18 years and the upper age limit is 25 years. Upper age relaxation is 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC and 10 years for Divyang/PWD, on submission of the relevant certificate.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for MbPA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs.100/-, payable by NEFT only with the UTR receipt attached to the form. SC, ST and physically handicapped candidates are not required to pay it.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for the MbPA apprentice posts?
faq.answer: Register on the NCVT MIS portal (www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in), download the form from www.mumbaiport.gov.in, fill it in, and submit it by hand or post with documents and the fee receipt to the ATC, Bhandar Bhavan, Mazgaon (East), Mumbai – 400010.

faq.question: Q8. How are MbPA COPA apprentices selected?
faq.answer: A merit list is prepared on the percentage of total marks in both semesters of the COPA ITI Trade Exam. Listed candidates then go through document verification and selection procedure at the ATC office, and selected candidates take a physical fitness test at the MbPA Hospital, Wadala.

faq.question: Q9. Does the MbPA apprenticeship lead to a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. MbPA has no obligation to offer employment during or after the apprenticeship, and an apprentice cannot claim employment on the ground of completing it.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates who have already done apprenticeship in COPA apply?
faq.answer: No. An applicant who has already undergone or is undergoing apprenticeship training in the same trade under the Apprentice Act, 1961 in any organization is not eligible to apply.
